Zahra Kay Ghar Mein Dekho Manzar Hai Kerbala Ka

Kufa Say Uth Raha Hay Taboot Murtaza Ka

Kufa Pay Chaa Gaee Hain Haey Zulm Ki Ghataeyn

Baqiya Say Arahi Hain Ronay Ki Phir Sadaeyn

Hilnay Laga Hai Roza Sultan-e-Ambiya Ka

Roya Tha Falak Us Par Roti Rahi Khudaai

Moula Nay Jub Wasiyat Abbas Ko Sunaee

Ghazi Hai Tu Muhafiz Zainab Ki Ub Rida Ka

Moula Kay Janazay Ko Hasnain Nay Uthaya

Zainab Ki Sadaaon Nai Kufay Ko Haey Hilaya

Logo Hai Yeh Janaza Damaad-e-Mustafa Ka

Badlay Hain Kis Tarha Say Andaaz Musalman Nay

Zalim Hai Kufi Shaami Daikha Hai Is Jahan Nay

Masjid Mei Khoon Bahaya Ummath Kay Payshwa Ka

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check -- src/data/lyrics/zahra-kay-ghar-mein-dekho-nw-ec6077905367.md && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from subprocess import check_output
p = 'src/data/lyrics/zahra-kay-ghar-mein-dekho-nw-ec6077905367.md'
old = check_output(['git','show',f'HEAD:{p}'], text=True).split('---',2)[2]
_, meta, body = Path(p).read_text().split('---',2)
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]
def verses(s):
    return [line.strip() for line in s.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().isdecimal()]
assert [s.casefold() for s in verses(old)] == [s.casefold() for s in verses(roman)]
for edition in (roman, body):
    assert [len(verses(block)) for block in edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')] == [2,3,3,3,3]
print('Verified 14 aligned verses and unchanged Roman wording.')
PY"
